Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(CHAPTER 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 16
G.N. No. S 537/1997
REVISED EDITION 1998
(15th June 1998)
[20th December 1997]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 1st December 1997:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 20th December 1997, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
(1)The Advance Medical Directive Act (Chapter 4A).
(2)The Central Provident Fund Act (Chapter 36).
(3)The Civil List and Pension Act (Chapter 44).
(4)The Customs Act (Chapter 70).
(5)The Employment of Foreign Workers Act (Chapter 91A).
(6)The Estate Duty Act (Chapter 96).
(7)The Evidence Act (Chapter 97).
(8)The Hijacking of Aircraft and Protection of Aircraft and International Airports Act (Chapter 124).
(9)The Immigration Act (Chapter 133).
(10)The Legal Profession Act (Chapter 161).
(11)The Notaries Public Act (Chapter 208).
(12)The Road Traffic Act (Chapter 276).
(13)The Singapore Academy of Law Act (Chapter 294A).
(14)The Singapore Tourism Board Act (Chapter 305B).
(15)The Singapore Tourism (Cess Collection) Act (Chapter 305C).
